gloss: as you wish; your will; understood (archaic/formal)

definitions.explanation: An honorific term for the will or wishes of a superior, or an acknowledgment meaning "understood" or "as you command."

examples.japanese: 「⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{用意|ようい}→用意：01746_youi⟧⟦せよ→する：00392_suru⟧」「{御意|ぎょい}」
⟦{殿様|とのさま}→殿様：10455_tonosama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご{御意|ぎょい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧。
「⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{件|けん}→件：11720_ken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{任|まか}せる→任せる：02417_makaseru⟧」「{御意|ぎょい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ございます→ございます：01300_gozaimasu⟧」
examples.english: "I'm leaving this matter to you." "As you wish, my lord."

notes:
HISTORICAL/ARCHAIC:
This is very formal, archaic language associated with feudal Japan. Used when addressing lords, royalty, or high-ranking officials.

MODERN USAGE:
- Historical dramas (⟦{時代劇|じだいげき}→時代劇：12968_jidaigeki⟧)
- Period novels
- Ironic/humorous use when pretending to be subservient
- Some traditional businesses or formal contexts

USAGE:
Used as a response to show understanding and compliance with an order from a superior. Similar to "Yes, my lord" or "As you command."

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{仰|おお}せ→仰せ：17571_oose⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧ - as you say
- ⟦{承知|しょうち}→承知：02086_shouchi⟧⟦いたしました→いたす：01314_itasu⟧ - understood (modern polite)
